questions.question: What is the past tense of "eat"?
questions.explanation: "Eat" is irregular. The past tense is "ate".

questions.question: Which tense talks about the future?
questions.explanation: "Will + verb" is used for future tense: "I will go tomorrow."

questions.question: What happens to verbs with he/she/it in present tense?
questions.explanation: In present tense with he/she/it, we add -s or -es: "She plays."

questions.question: What is the past tense of "was" for "they"?
Fill in: "Tomorrow, we ___ visit our grandparents."
questions.explanation: "Tomorrow" is future, so we use "will": "We will visit..."
